title: Naturally Crispy Venezuelan Snapper Fish Roast
description: This vegan friendly dish features snapper fish with a yeasty and crispy exterior, showcasing the flavors of Venezuela. The roast is made with a variety of ingredients to create a delicious and show stopping meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the snapper fish fillets and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk together the yeast, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, onion, bell pepper, tomato, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the snapper fish fillets to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the fish from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the fish in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the fish is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the fish from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the fish hot, garnished with fresh herbs and lemon wedges.
